title: Obama's Area 51 remark, later walked back

The very next day, he had to buy it back.

tellings.link_reason: Obama walking back his aliens and Area 51 remark is the same event as this story.

as_told.title: Obama walks back the aliens remark; Trump takes the bait

plain: In 2026, the story goes, the former US president Barack Obama said something about Area 51, a secret military base in Nevada, and alien beings kept underground there, and then took it back. Michels mentions it himself in passing, without a source, and says Obama sort of walked his statement back. Bryce Zabel, a guest talking about Hollywood's ties to the CIA, also tells it without naming a source. He says Obama had to take the remark back the very next day, and that Donald Trump, the sitting president, took the bait.
